searchHelperCalls: R="<CANDIDATE>/scripts"; cd "$WIKI_MASTER_VAULT"; node "$R/search.mjs" "retries total attempts duplicate identifier digest" --json --limit=6 2>&1 | head -60; node "$R/search.mjs" "retries attempts duplicate" --include-raw --limit=5 2>&1 | tail -15; node "$R/resolve-evidence.mjs" "wiki/sources/Harbor Retry Protocol.md:12"; grep -n "" "wiki/sources/Harbor Retry Protocol.md" | sed -n 12,17p | cut -c1-80
shellReferenceLoadCommands: cd "<CANDIDATE>/skills"; cat wiki-researcher/references/discover.md wiki-maintainer/references/access.md; echo ENV; env | grep -i -E "TEMP|TMPDIR|WIKI|VAULT"

cd "<CANDIDATE>/skills"; cat wiki-researcher/references/capture.md wiki-maintainer/references/operations.md wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md wiki-maintainer/references/efficacy.md | head -400; ls ../scripts | head -50
cd "<CANDIDATE>/skills"; cat wiki-researcher/references/ingest.md | cut -c1-900; cat "$WIKI_MASTER_VAULT/raw/clippings/Harbor Retry Protocol.md"; cat "$WIKI_MASTER_VAULT/AGENTS.md" | head -60
cd "<CANDIDATE>/skills/wiki-user/references"; head -c 2500 search.md; echo ----; head -c 2000 query.md

scoring: Facts only. Independent reviewer determines gate outcome; process exit is not a pass.
